channel.title: Long Island Business News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Long Island Business News (libn.com)

item.title: Powerful winter storm disrupts travel and closes schools across the US northeast
item.description: A powerful winter storm forced school closures and widespread travel disruptions across the US Northeast, with heavy snow, strong winds, and emergency measures in place.

item.title: Developer planning another Amazon facility in Melville
item.description: Hartz Mountain Industries plans a new 125,000-square-foot Amazon facility on Spagnoli Road in Melville, according to real estate industry sources.

item.title: Glen Cove Hospital earns U.S. Congress-established quality award
item.description: Glen Cove Hospital received the 2024 Malcolm Baldrige National Quality Award, for leadership, patient care and operations.

item.title: Burlington Stores opening at Federal Realty’s Melville Mall
item.description: Burlington Stores will open a 32,314 sq ft location in Melville Mall on March 6, featuring a refreshed store layout.

item.title: Middle-market firms, including on LI, see growth amid challenges
item.description: Middle-market firms, including on Long Island, showed strong financial gains in 2025 but face rising cost pressures and global uncertainty, according to Valley Bank's survey.

item.title: Metropolitan Realty Associates secures $33.2M refi for last-mile asset
item.description: Metropolitan Realty Associates secured a $33.2 million refinancing loan from Webster Bank for its last-mile distribution facility in South Windsor, Connecticut.

item.title: Karine Jean-Pierre honored by Black Women of Long Island at Westbury event
item.description: Karine Jean-Pierre, former White House press secretary, was honored at a Black Women of Long Island event in Westbury, celebrating eadership.

item.title: NY home care providers seek equitable funding in state budget
item.description: The Home Care Association of New York State urges lawmakers to allocate equitable funding in the final budget to support home care providers and workforce needs.

item.title: Nonprofit relocating to newly renovated Plainview property
item.description: Helen Keller Services leased nearly 15,000 sq ft at 303 Sunnyside Blvd in Plainview after selling its Hempstead building.
